name: MOAG v0.9.0 - Validation and Context Intelligence
description: Implement a scalable validation engine (web/mobile/desktop) with context/token optimization, evidence capture, and quality gates.

tasks.name: Extend plan and run schema for validation + context budgets
tasks.prompt: Update MOAG schema and runtime model types to support validation targets, execution profiles (quick/pr/full), and context budget fields. Add backward-compatible defaults and parser validation. Update tests for schema parsing and defaulting behavior.

tasks.name: Add runner contracts for target-aware validation tasks
tasks.prompt: Refactor runner contracts to support a unified validate task with target adapters and profile-based stage selection. Keep existing task behavior unchanged for legacy plans.

tasks.name: Implement web validation adapter
tasks.prompt: Add web validation adapter support for browser test execution hooks (for example Playwright/Cypress commands) with standardized result mapping into MOAG run artifacts.

tasks.name: Implement mobile validation adapter
tasks.prompt: Add mobile adapter hooks for emulator/device validation commands and artifact collection (screenshots, logs, traces). Include capability checks and explicit skip-state reporting when devices are unavailable.

tasks.name: Implement desktop validation adapter
tasks.prompt: Add desktop app validation adapter hooks (for example Electron or platform UI tests) with the same normalized artifact output used by web and mobile.

tasks.name: Build context retrieval cascade
tasks.prompt: Implement staged context retrieval in context-builder: symbol/project hints first, then rg/glob search, then optional semantic retrieval provider. Return ranked spans instead of whole files when possible.

tasks.name: Add token budget manager
tasks.prompt: Add budget controls for discovery, analysis, and fix phases. Enforce soft limits in prompt construction and expose telemetry fields for used vs budgeted context.

tasks.name: Define local semantic search provider interface
tasks.prompt: Create a provider interface for optional local semantic indexing/search backends so MOAG can integrate tools like GrepAI-style retrievers without hard coupling. Add deterministic fallback when provider confidence is low.

tasks.name: Expand artifact schema for validation evidence
tasks.prompt: Expand run artifact schema to include target, stage, logs, screenshots, traces, and failure summary metadata. Keep compatibility with existing history entries.

tasks.name: Surface validation and context metrics in dashboard
tasks.prompt: Update dashboard and execution detail panels to show target-wise pass/fail, skipped-capability states, flaky indicators, and context budget usage.

tasks.name: Add quick/pr/full validation profiles
tasks.prompt: Implement profile presets to select stage depth and target matrix for quick local checks, PR gates, and nightly full validations.

tasks.name: Add CI usage docs and sample commands
tasks.prompt: Document recommended CI wiring for periodic and PR validation using the new validate task model, including artifact retention, flaky test handling, and failure policies.

tasks.name: Add regression tests for compatibility and fallback paths
tasks.prompt: Add focused regression tests for legacy plan compatibility, missing adapter capability behavior, and semantic provider fallback to rg when confidence is low.

tasks.name: Prepare changelog and release checklist for v0.9.0
tasks.prompt: Update changelog with v0.9.0 highlights and add a release checklist focused on validation engine rollout, migration notes, and known limitations.
